description.narrative: The ‘ENABLE, EMPOWER and TRANSFORM: Using a ‘holistic family centred model’ to empower marginalised children, youth, women, and their families in Wakiso, Mubende and Terego District, Uganda during the Covid pandemic’ project aims to reduce poverty, hunger and vulnerability in children, youth, women and their families during the Covid pandemic in three selected districts in Uganda. The objective is to pursue this through health and nutritional support, vocational training, and sustainable livelihoods interventions, focused at household and community level. The key activities include the provision of antenatal services to vulnerable pregnant women, cervical cancer screening, education of vulnerable youths on SRHR and where they can access services, training in entrepreneurship, wealth creation, business development, and employment, vocational training provided to vulnerable youths, and local Government Officials mentored on the application of the principles of good governance, gender, disability, environment and human rights mainstreaming.
